<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template for the Peterson reaction. The forward reaction breaks a ketone (or carbonyl) and a trimethylsilyl group, and forms a C‑C double bond. We'll search the template catalog using only these functional‑group criteria, omitting bond specifications which require atom‑index formats.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "trimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
